products.title: eReader Magnetic Reading Light
products.body_html:
Light up your reading, anywhere.

Please use this without a case; otherwise, the magnetic strength may not be sufficient.

The Xteink Magnetic Reading Light is a versatile, rechargeable reading lamp designed for effortless night reading.

With its magnetic back and clip-on design, it attaches securely to your Xteink X3 or X4, or clips directly onto a book, providing comfortable illumination wherever you read.

products.title: XTEINK X4 Classic (X4 V2) Tempered Glass Screen Protector
products.body_html:
Designed for Clarity and Protection.

The XTEINK X4 Classic (X4 V2) Screen Protector is custom-made for the XTEINK X4 Classic (X4 V2), ensuring a precise fit that preserves the device’s clean, minimal design. Crafted from premium tempered glass, it protects your screen from scratches, dust, and fingerprints — while maintaining the natural paper-like reading experience.

Each pack includes 1 screen protector.

products.title: XTEINK X4 Classic (X4 V2) Matte Screen Protector
products.body_html:
Designed for Paper-Like Reading and Daily Protection

The Xteink XTEINK X4 Classic (X4 V2) Matte Screen Protector is custom-designed for the XTEINK X4 Classic (X4 V2), ensuring a perfect fit that complements the device's sleek, minimalist design.

Made from high-quality PET material, it reduces glare and reflections, providing a softer, paper-like reading experience that’s gentler on the eyes — especially during extended reading sessions or in brightly lit environments.

At the same time, it offers dependable protection against scratches, dust, and everyday wear, keeping your screen in pristine condition while maintaining a natural, paper-like feel.

Each pack includes 2 screen protectors.

products.title: XTEINK X4 Classic (X4 V2) Magnetic Case - Multiple Colors
products.body_html:
Protect your XTEINK X4 Classic (X4 V2) in Style

Keep your XTEINK X4 Classic (X4 V2) safe with our ultra-lightweight magnetic case. This case is designed to perfectly fit the XTEINK X4 Classic (X4 V2), with one side securely attaching to the back of the device, offering reliable protection without compromising on design. Available in six vibrant colors, it combines functionality with sleek aesthetics.

products.title: XTEINK X4 Classic (X4 V2) Protective Case
products.body_html:
Light protection with a smooth matte look

This hard shell case provides everyday protection while maintaining the slim profile of the device.

Protective Case is designed specifically for the XTEINK X4 Classic (X4 V2)
. Made from lightweight polycarbonate material, it provides everyday protection while maintaining the slim profile of the device. Featuring a matte look with a smooth surface, the case delivers a soft, understated appearance without a rough or textured feel. It stays comfortable in the hand while keeping a clean, low-gloss finish.

Weighing just 14 g, it fits closely to the XTEINK X4 Classic (X4 V2) body without adding bulk.

products.title: eReader Adhesive Metal Ring
products.body_html:
Attach your reading, anywhere.

The Xteink eReader Magnetic Stick-On Ring is designed to expand how and where you use your Xteink eReader.

Featuring an adhesive backing on one side and a built-in magnet on the other, it allows your device to attach securely to a variety of surfaces, making everyday use more flexible and convenient.

Whether at your desk, by your phone, bedside, or on the go, it helps keep your reading within easy reach.
